Attribute.Name: Legacy IDs
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="list2multivalue(
    unique(
        listconcatenate(          
            iterate(
                iterate(
                    iterate(
                        iterate(
                            references('', 'BPRemittanceReference'),
                            'referencetarget()'
                        ),
                        'references("","GoldenRecordReferences")'
                    ),
                    'referencetarget()'
                ),
                'concatenate(stepname()," (",stepid(),")")'
            ),
            iterate(
                iterate(
                    iterate(
                        iterate(
                            references('', 'BPBillingReference'),
                            'referencetarget()'
                        ),
                        'references("","GoldenRecordReferences")'
                    ),
                    'referencetarget()'
                ),
                'concatenate(stepname()," (",stepid(),")")'
            )
        )
    )
)"/>
